feedback_by_option.fil: Luma ang directory; maaaring nagbago na ang numero.
feedback_by_option.en: The directory is old; the number may have changed.

feedback_by_option.fil: Dapat nakabatay ang payo sa kasalukuyang opisyal na babala at kumpirmadong ruta.
feedback_by_option.en: Advice should rest on the current official warning and a confirmed route.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring hindi na kumpirmado ang dating site; itanong sa DRRM focal person.
feedback_by_option.en: Last year's site may not be confirmed now; ask the DRRM focal person.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring mali ang lumang impormasyon, at maaaring maantala nito ang tulong.
feedback_by_option.en: Old information may be wrong, and wrong information can delay help.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ipaabot lamang ang beripikadong mensahe, kasama ang oras at source.
feedback_by_option.en: Relay only the verified message, with its time and source.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag gumawa ng sariling evacuation order; sundin ang lokal na awtoridad.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not invent an evacuation order; follow the local authority.
